page_title: Mobcoder AI - Custom AI Development Company
clean_text:
Mobcoder AI is a custom AI software development company. We provide AI solutions that help businesses automate processes, predict outcomes, and scale smarter across industries globally.

Core offerings include: Conversational AI, AI Integration and Deployment, AI Agent Development, Generative AI Development, and AI Automation.

Mobcoder is trusted by 150+ brands. We build, deploy, and optimize AI solutions end to end—from identifying the right use cases to deploying scalable systems.

Service areas: AI Strategy and Consultation, AI Product Development, Generative AI Development, Agentic AI Development, AI Chatbot Development, Enterprise AI System Integration, Machine Learning and LLM Solutions, Intelligent Process Automation, Research and Innovation, Cybersecurity and Compliance.

AI Strategy and Consultation includes: AI use case discovery aligned with business goals, ROI modeling and cost-benefit analysis, data readiness assessment, AI architecture and technology stack planning, and framework discussion to accelerate deployment.

page_title: Agentic AI and AI Agent Development
clean_text:
Mobcoder specializes in Agentic AI Development and AI Agent Development. We design autonomous and semi-autonomous agents that integrate with business workflows, including customer support automation, internal copilots, and multi-step task execution using LLMs and tool calling.

Capabilities include: multi-agent orchestration, RAG-powered knowledge agents, tool-use and function-calling pipelines, LangGraph and LangChain-based workflows, agent evaluation and observability, and production deployment on AWS/GCP/Azure.

Common use cases: AI sales agents, AI support agents, internal operations copilots, document processing agents, agentic RPA pipelines, and research automation.

Mobcoder delivers Generative AI Development and Machine Learning and LLM Solutions. Capabilities include custom model integration, RAG systems, fine-tuning strategies, prompt engineering, and production deployment of chatbots and content generation pipelines.

Tech stack: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Mistral, LLaMA, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, Qdrant, Hugging Face, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI.

Deliverables: production RAG systems with hybrid retrieval, fine-tuned domain models, multimodal AI pipelines, streaming LLM APIs, and LLM evaluation frameworks.

page_title: AI Chatbot and Conversational AI Development
clean_text:
Mobcoder builds AI Chatbot Development and Conversational AI solutions for web and mobile. We focus on grounded responses, enterprise integration, analytics, and scalable deployment for sales, support, and internal help use cases.

Features: real-time streaming responses, session memory, lead qualification flows, intent classification, multi-turn dialogue management, CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce), and embeddable widget deployment.

Deployment targets: website chat widgets, Slack bots, WhatsApp, Teams, and custom mobile SDKs.

Mobcoder AI consulting helps organizations identify high-impact AI opportunities. Services include AI use case discovery aligned with business goals, ROI modeling, data readiness and gap analysis, AI architecture planning, and technology stack recommendations to accelerate deployment.

Engagement format: 2-week discovery sprint → architecture document → phased implementation roadmap. Deliverables include a prioritized AI opportunity matrix, build-vs-buy recommendations, and a staffing plan.

Enterprise AI System Integration connects AI capabilities to CRMs, data warehouses, and existing software. Intelligent Process Automation reduces manual work through workflow automation combined with AI decision steps. Mobcoder also supports cybersecurity and compliance considerations for production AI systems.

Integration targets: Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP, Workday, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure. We build REST and GraphQL APIs, event-driven pipelines with Kafka/SQS, and real-time data sync layers.

Beyond AI, Mobcoder provides full-stack product engineering — mobile applications (iOS and Android with React Native and Flutter), web platforms (React, Next.js, Vue), cloud-native backend services (Node.js, FastAPI, Django, Go), and dedicated engineering teams for product delivery and team augmentation.

Engagement models: fixed-scope delivery, dedicated squad (3–12 engineers), or staff augmentation. Teams include senior engineers, tech leads, QA, and DevOps.

Contact Mobcoder AI to start a project. Reach the team for general questions or to request a quote. Phone: +1 3067169910 (USA/Canada) and +91 87503 13446 (India). Email: hello@mobcoder.ai. Offices: Seattle HQ (USA), Noida (India), Singapore, Vancouver (Canada), and Australia.

Engagement flow: book a free 30-minute discovery call, then receive a scoped proposal with timeline and team composition. Book via Calendly: https://calendly.com/hello-mobcoder/mobcoderai

Mobcoder offers three primary engagement models:

1. Fixed-Scope Project Delivery — Ideal for well-defined products or features with a clear spec. Pricing is quoted after a discovery call and scoping session. Typical projects range from $15,000 for MVPs to $150,000+ for full-scale AI platforms, depending on complexity and team size.

2. Dedicated Squad Augmentation — A dedicated team of 3–10 engineers, designers, and AI specialists embedded in your product organization. Monthly retainer model. Typical monthly cost ranges from $18,000 to $80,000 depending on team size and seniority mix.

3. Ongoing AI Operations Support — Monitoring, optimization, retraining, and scaling of deployed AI systems. Monthly retainer starting at $5,000/month.

All engagements start with a free 30-minute discovery call and a scoping session. We provide a detailed proposal with timeline, team composition, and cost breakdown within 3–5 business days. No hidden fees — the proposal price is the final price.

To get a custom quote, book a discovery call or fill out the contact form at https://mobcoder.ai/contact-us

page_title: Case Study: Nap Detect — AI Road Safety Mobile App
clean_text:
Nap Detect is an AI-enabled mobile safety application designed to reduce road accidents caused by driver drowsiness and distraction. Mobcoder built the AI core including facial recognition and analysis, on-device machine learning models, driver fatigue detection, and AI for accident prevention.

The app runs entirely on-device for real-time performance without network dependency, using computer vision to monitor driver alertness and trigger safety alerts before accidents occur.

Key technologies: Facial recognition, on-device AI models, machine learning on mobile, computer vision. View full case studies at https://mobcoder.ai/case-studies

page_title: Case Study: GovGig — AI Regulatory Assistant for Federal Contracting
clean_text:

Key technologies: AI-powered regulatory assistant, intelligent document processing, compliance automation, generative AI for enterprise, conversational AI, context-aware AI systems. View full case studies at https://mobcoder.ai/case-studies
